publicationRules.sourceRule: These are retrospective research records. Present statistics in the period story only after publication. The 2002 CPS table was released July 28, 2004 and the 2004 CPS table May 25, 2005. FEC final compilations are retrospective. Election-night material requires a separate contemporary source.

sources.reading: Daily regular retail average by state and DC. The printed price values use dollar-scale decimals (Ohio 1.420). The table introduction calls the prices cents. Stored as mills per U.S. gallon, 1420 for Ohio. A single day supplies no weekly or annual mean.
